{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Upgrades Button.png|frameless|left]]
Upgrades can be purchased with bars and gold. You can unlock more upgrades by leveling up.

Upgrades are lost when [[Prestige|prestiging]].

===Damage Calculation===
The Base Damage amount from "Upgrade Pickaxe" can be calculated with the following equation:<br>
<math>\text{Base damage} \; = \; \frac{(\text{Level} + 1) \times (\text{Level} + 2)}{2}</math>​

===Upgrade Cost===
The cost of an upgrade scales linearly for the first ten levels, then with a linear times exponential formula for every level after.

The cost of the first ten levels can be calculated with the following expression:

<math>\text{Cost} \; = \; \text{Base cost} \times N</math>​

Subsequently, the cost of levels 11 and onward can be calculated with this expression:

<math>\text{Cost} \; = \; \text{Base cost} \times 1.3^{(N-10)} \times N</math>​
